name: markdown-editor
title: Markdown Editor
description: A live rich text editor with formatting toolbar and built-in switch toggle. Edit and preview in one view. Compound or composed mode. Works with FormField.

docs.lead: A live rich text editor powered by TipTap. Format text with the toolbar and see results instantly — no separate preview mode needed. Includes a built-in switch toggle for multilingual content.
docs.usage:
import * as MarkdownEditor from "@/components/ui/markdown-editor"

<MarkdownEditor.Composed
  placeholder="Start writing..."
  onChange={(html) => console.log(html)}
/>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Basic rich text editor with formatting toolbar.

examples.title: With Toggle
examples.description: Editor with built-in SwitchToggle for language switching.
examples.code:
<MarkdownEditor.Composed
  placeholder="Write here..."
  toggleItems={[
    { value: 'english', label: 'English' },
    { value: 'french', label: 'French' },
  ]}
  defaultToggleValue="english"
/>

examples.title: Controlled Toggle
examples.description: Controlled toggle with per-language content stored separately.

examples.title: Compound
examples.description: Full compound mode using useMarkdownEditorState hook with custom layout.

examples.title: With FormField
examples.description: Inside a FormField with label, required indicator, and hint.
examples.code:
<FormField.Root label="Description" required hint="Describe in detail.">
  <MarkdownEditor.Composed toggleItems={items} defaultToggleValue="english" />
</FormField.Root>

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: Disabled editor with muted toolbar and content.

examples.title: With Default Content
examples.description: Editor pre-filled with rich content including bold text and task lists.

api.name: MarkdownEditor.Root
api.description: The root container. Accepts an editor instance and provides context.

props.name: hasError
props.description: Error state applied to the content area.

api.name: MarkdownEditor.DefaultToolbar
api.description: Pre-built toolbar buttons (bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, checklist, ordered list, link). Reads editor from context and tracks active state automatically.

api.name: MarkdownEditor.ToolbarButton
api.description: An individual toolbar button with hover and active states.

api.name: MarkdownEditor.ToolbarGroup
api.description: Groups toolbar buttons with consistent spacing.

api.name: MarkdownEditor.Content
api.description: The TipTap editor content area. Renders the EditorContent from context.

props.name: height
props.description: Min-height of the editor content area. Accepts any CSS value.

api.name: MarkdownEditor.Composed
api.description: Props-driven composed mode. Creates the editor internally.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback with HTML string on every change.

props.name: toggleItems
props.description: Items for built-in SwitchToggle. Hidden when omitted.

props.name: height
props.description: Min-height of the editor content area.

api.name: useMarkdownEditorState
api.description: Hook that creates a TipTap editor instance. Use with compound mode.

api.name: executeAction
api.description: Executes a formatting action on the editor. Use in compound mode for custom toolbar buttons.

api.name: isActionActive
api.description: Checks if a formatting action is currently active at the cursor position.
